basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and used for one glyph in special grade batch 1 and eight in batch 2. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise.

曩.reason: Ja writes the inner strokes of the 日 and 襄 bodies in a different order (three strokes over 60°, max 99°); the simplified file leaves one at 61°.
